'''''Kuma 2''''' was a [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] used by the [[Zaarin coup forces]]. It was present at the [[Battle of Gwar]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

''Kuma 2''{{'s}} sister ships ''[[Kuma 1]]'' and ''[[Kuma 3]]'' were present at Grand Admiral [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] [[Supply Base]] orbiting [[Gwar]] when Imperial forces loyal to the Emperor assaulted the platform and its flotilla of warships to strike a major blow against Zaarin's war efforts. As the base's defenses were routed, ''Kuma 2'' arrived to reinforce Zaarin's forces, jumping in close proximity to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Courageous (Imperial-class)|''Courageous'']] with a reinforcement of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]]. Despite the ferocity of the daring attack, Zaarin's TIE Defenders were routed and ''Kuma 2'' itself fell to a heavy missile attack at the hands of [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] flying an advanced [[Missile Boat]].
